issue_title: OverflowError when total=inf is passed to format_meter
issue_body: Passing total=float('inf') to tqdm's format_meter crashes with OverflowError instead of behaving like an unknown total. Expected: total=inf should be treated the same as total=None (unknown total), per the discussion in issue #651.
difficulty_notes: Easy — single function (format_meter in tqdm/std.py), fix is a 4-line conditional, test is one added assertion inside an existing test function. Good sanity-check task for the agent's basic loop.
